map.JSON 工具支持「压缩」与「美化」两种模式：压缩用于减小存储/传输体积并显示压: The JSON tool supports both 'minify' and 'beautify' modes: minify shrinks storage / transfer size and shows the compression ratio, beautify aids reading and debugging. All processing happens locally in the browser.
map.压缩模式：去除空白与换行，显示压缩率: Minify mode: strip whitespace and newlines, show the compression ratio
map.美化模式：按层级缩进，便于阅读: Beautify mode: indent by level for easier reading
map.显示原始/输出体积对比: Show the original / output size comparison
map.解析错误定位提示，方便排查: Parse error location hints for easier troubleshooting
map.接口调试：把返回的压缩 JSON 美化阅读: Interface debugging: beautify returned minified JSON for reading
map.存储优化：压缩配置/缓存数据减小体积: Storage optimization: compress configuration or cached data to reduce size
map.把 JSON 压缩后放进 URL 参数: Put minified JSON into a URL parameter
map.粘贴 JSON 到输入框: Paste JSON into the input box
map.选择「压缩」或「美化」模式（支持实时切换）: Choose 'minify' or 'beautify' mode (switchable in real time)
map.查看体积与压缩率统计: View size and compression ratio statistics
map.压缩率可能为负（小 JSON 反而变大），属正常现象: The compression ratio can be negative (small JSON gets bigger instead), which is normal
map.美化后的 JSON 缩进为 2 空格: Beautified JSON is indented by 2 spaces
map.粘贴前确认内容为合法 JSON，否则会提示错误位置: Confirm the content is valid JSON before pasting, otherwise the error position is reported
map.压缩和美化哪个好？: Which is better, minify or beautify?
map.传输/存储用压缩，阅读/调试用美化；两者不会改变数据本身。: Use minify for transmission and storage, beautify for reading and debugging; neither changes the data itself.
map.为什么压缩后反而更大？: Why does it get bigger after minifying?
map.小 JSON 的空格占比高，压缩收益小甚至为负，属正常。: Small JSON has a high whitespace share, so minification gains little or even goes negative, which is normal.
